title: In Swing — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The in-swinger comes at you from outside off
And then it doesn't
It changes its mind mid-flight
Or rather it never had your mind in mind at all — you had its

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
L'in-swinger viene verso di te dall'esterno [The in-swinger comes at you from outside]
E poi no [And then it doesn't]
Cambia idea a metà volo [It changes its mind mid-flight]
O meglio, non ha mai avuto la tua mente in mente — tu avevi la sua [Or rather it never had your mind in mind — you had its]

[Chorus — English]
In swing says — you think you know where this is going
In swing says — look at the seam, look at the grip
In swing says — that's already too much thinking
In swing says — you've already missed

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Der In-Swing sagt — du glaubst zu wissen wohin das geht [In swing says — you think you know where this is going]
Der In-Swing sagt — schau auf die Naht, schau auf den Griff [In swing says — look at the seam, look at the grip]
Der In-Swing sagt — das ist schon zu viel Denken [In swing says — that's already too much thinking]
Der In-Swing sagt — du hast schon verfehlt [In swing says — you've already missed]

[Verse 3 — English]
The in-swinger is not deceptive — it's honest
It goes exactly where physics says it will

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
In swing
In swing italiano [In swing]
Der In-Swing [In swing]
That's my boy
